established: All-pairs Teacher utility ranking is strongly state-alignment sensitive: aligned true Champion-relative gain beat the median of five whole-group Teacher shuffles in five of five seeds in all four regimes.
The pairwise surrogate suppresses harmful movement relative to absolute CE robustly: harm-vs-ABS wins were 5/5, 4/5, 5/5, and 4/5 across the four regimes.
In NOISY_TEACHER and NEAR_OPTIMAL_CHAMPION, pairwise ranking beat binary selective on both true capture and true Champion-relative gain in all five seeds.
NEAR_OPTIMAL_CHAMPION passed every preregistered rule, showing the surrogate can work under at least one difficult Champion-relative regime.
not_established: Correct state-conditioned pairwise Direction ordering is not sufficient for universal Champion-relative decision improvement: CLEAN_CONDITIONAL and WEAK_CONDITIONAL_STRONG_MARGINAL achieved only 2/5 capture and gain wins versus binary selective.
Under NOISY_TEACHER, pairwise ranking did not suppress harm versus advantage-weighted selective often enough, with only 2/5 wins.
The pairwise surrogate therefore does not qualify for consumed TRAIN-only market shadow or canonical replacement.
mechanistic_interpretation.cross_experiment_localization: M2.2 through M2.2D consistently show that aligned Teacher information is learnable and that null-alignment sensitivity can be made strong. The remaining failure is not absence of state-conditioned signal. It is the conversion from Teacher utility evidence into a policy change that simultaneously captures available Champion-relative advantage and controls harmful corrections across heterogeneous regimes. Pairwise ordering improves relational geometry but still optimizes ordering rather than the actual Champion-relative decision value of the resulting action.
mechanistic_interpretation.next_design_implication: Test a direct Teacher Champion-relative decision-regret surrogate in fresh synthetic seeds. The next objective should use existing Teacher mean utilities directly as a differentiable decision-value signal, make no Teacher probability target, introduce no CE reweighting, temperature, threshold, margin sweep, or new model capacity, and retain whole-group shuffle controls.
